verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a SaaS analytics product, but the evidence pack shows no natural-language query interface, AI assistant, or MCP integration. Plausible offers only a dashboard and a structured Stats API, which takes JSON queries, not natural-language commands. Probes for llms.txt, docs.md and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404, so nothing points to agent-friendly natural-language control.
